title: Add processing router after upload and antivirus

context.summary: Route uploaded documents by file type after upload or clean antivirus scan before creating modality-specific processing jobs.
context.background: TASK-38 added derived artifact schema. Multimodal processing needs a dedicated planning stage so antivirus, routing and handlers stay separated and disabled handlers do not create jobs.

in: Add a document.route processing job type and migration.
Add a core document routing module for MIME, extension and magic-byte classification.
Enqueue document.route after upload when asynchronous scan is not required.
Enqueue document.route after clean ClamAV scans instead of directly enqueueing extraction.
Register a worker route processor that creates only enabled downstream jobs.
Add document processing route configuration and document it in .env.example, Compose and docs.
Update integration and validation checks to use route jobs.
out: Implement PDF, image, audio, video, OCR, ASR, face or keyframe processors.
Implement derived artifact writes for routed handlers.

acceptance_criteria: document.route exists in core queue types, Drizzle schema and a forward migration without changing 0000_initial_schema.
Uploads with no async scan return a route_job and do not require manual extraction enqueue.
Clean ClamAV scans enqueue document.route instead of document.extract.
The worker route processor classifies text, PDF, image, audio, video and unknown files.
Disabled handlers do not create downstream jobs.
Text routes create the existing document.extract job.
Configuration supports modality enable/required switches and video max keyframes.
Documentation describes the routing stage and new configuration.

manual_checks: Confirm the task branch starts from master.
Confirm no modality processor is enqueued when the handler is disabled or not implemented.

risks: A route migration changes the processing_job_type enum for existing databases; it must be applied before route jobs are created.
Future modality tasks must add processors before enabling those handlers by default.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
